name: resilience to stress
description: A general tendency to recover quickly from negative emotions caused by stress.
examples: Going back despite having trouble the first time.

commentaries.quote: Life doesn’t get easier or more forgiving, we get stronger and more resilient.
The oak fought the wind and was broken, the willow bent when it must and survived.
The true measure of a person is not where they stand in times of comfort, but rather where they stand during challenges and controversies.
Don’t measure each day by the harvest you reap; instead, consider the seeds you plant.
Too much resilience could make people overly tolerant of adversity.

Toxic positivity mandates that you act like nothing is wrong. You have to focus on the positive and block negative emotions, forcing yourself to be productive. Such productivity is thinly disguised as denial or avoidance.
